metricSemantics.elapsed: Measured wall time through complete analyzeRepository return, including exports; phase boundaries sampled synchronously.
metricSemantics.rss: Instantaneous process-wide resident bytes at boundaries; shared/native/compiler memory not attributed.
metricSemantics.maxRss: Kernel process-wide cumulative high-water, KiB; phase attribution is the interval between observations.
metricSemantics.v8Heap: Instantaneous used and committed allocator bytes; includes garbage awaiting collection; committed is not RSS.
metricSemantics.external: Instantaneous V8 external/ArrayBuffer counters overlap and do not cover all native allocations.
metricSemantics.cpu: Measured cumulative process user/system microseconds differenced across phase boundaries; no subsystem CPU attribution.
metricSemantics.allocated: V8 cumulative allocated bytes differenced across the phase; not retained heap or peak.
metricSemantics.counts: Exact container entry counts at the observation point, not distinct objects or retained heap bytes.
metricSemantics.planBytes: Exact existing canonical UTF-8 byte charge for the whole dependency recipe plan; not heap size.
metricSemantics.gc: Observed GC entries and pauses; no requested forced GC.
metricSemantics.sampling: Estimated surviving JS allocations at requested 32768-byte intervals, categorized by allocating call stacks. Not dominator or reachability proof.

projectionSizes.method: Complete sc_projection_rows joined to sealed fact payloads; UTF-8 length of value_json or complete payloadEntity canonical, including wrapper, summed per pass. Claim-key UTF-8 bytes counted per row. Serialized sizes are not retained heap/RSS; no GC or object materialization requested.
projectionSizes.sql:
SELECT r.partition_key,p.kind,COUNT(*) n,SUM(length(CAST(CASE WHEN json_extract(f.value_json,'$.payloadEntity') IS NOT NULL THEN e.canonical ELSE f.value_json END AS BLOB))) payload_bytes,SUM(length(CAST(c.key AS BLOB))) claim_key_bytes
FROM sc_projection_rows p JOIN sc_runs r ON r.id=p.run JOIN sc_claims c ON c.id=p.claim JOIN sc_facts f ON f.id=c.fact LEFT JOIN sc_entities e ON e.key=json_extract(f.value_json,'$.payloadEntity') WHERE r.partition_key LIKE 'analysis/%' GROUP BY r.id,p.kind ORDER BY r.id,p.kind
